name: oss-init
tagline: Zero-dependency CLI to scaffold, audit, and refresh OSS repos
description: oss-init is a CLI with zero runtime dependencies that scaffolds, audits, and refreshes open-source repositories, with bilingual support for Node.js and Python projects. It targets the often-ignored maintenance side of open source: standing up a new repo with sane defaults, auditing what is stale, and refreshing structure as conventions evolve. It sits exactly at the 100-star filter threshold, a niche OSS-maintenance tool that few people talk about.
highlights: Scaffold, audit, and refresh OSS repos from one CLI
Targets the neglected maintenance side of open source
curatorNote: Everyone scaffolds, nobody maintains. A zero-dependency CLI that makes the refresh-and-audit loop a one-liner fills a real gap in the OSS lifecycle.
